Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Class AIHub

java.lang.Object
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AIHub
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AIHub extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The entry point of the AI model hub: sends an app's jobs to the models of its AIConfig, binding each job to a model as late as possible, with per-model slots, provider and app rate limits, retries and guarded fallbacks, and reports through each job's JobListener. 
 AIConfig config = AIConfigLoader.load( "classpath:/app.ai.json" ) ;
 AIHub    hub    = AIHub.create( config, new AIHub.Options(
                           historyFile, RoutingPolicy.inOrder(), "my-app" ) ) ;
 JobHandle h = hub.submit( new AIJob<>( payload, List.of( "main" ),
                           model -> request, () -> true, listener ) ) ;
Logs on ai.config (the configuration, at load), ai.engine (each job's binding, attempts, retries, fallbacks, escalations and end; limits and state changes) and ai.gateway.<name> (transport errors). Thread-safe.

    • submit

      public <P, R> JobHandle submit(AIJob<P,R> job, Priority priority)
      Queue job. A job none of whose roots has a usable model fails at once: its listener's JobListener.failed(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, java.lang.String, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.FailureKind) is called before this returns.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a root is not in the config

    • setPassthrough

      public boolean setPassthrough(String modelId, boolean on)
      Set model modelId to pass its jobs through, or to take them again. While it passes them through it takes no jobs: those that would go to it (new ones, retries, handed-back ones) go to the models of its passthrough fallback guard (else its default one), and wait for it if it has neither. Its requests in flight finish. Kept in memory only, for this hub.
      Returns:
      true if that changed it
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the app has no such model

    • abortRequest

      public boolean abortRequest(long jobId)
      Abort job jobId's request in flight (see HubStatus.requests()), e.g. one that hangs. The attempt fails as a FailureKind.TIMEOUT, so the job goes on as after a timeout: a retry, the model's timeout fallback, or its end (with its provisional result, if it was escalated).
      Returns:
      false if the job has no request in flight
